title: A Koszul-regular immersion of spaces is a local complete intersection morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For S a scheme, any Koszul-regular immersion i : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is an lci morphism. The retained proof follows the definitions: Koszul-regular immersion (definition-regular-immersion) supplies an etale cover V -> Y by a scheme such that X x_Y V is a scheme and the pullback immersion is Koszul-regular on schemes; the schemes case (More on Morphisms, regular-immersion-lci) makes X x_Y V -> V lci; definition-lci for spaces then concludes. Retained author proof at lines 11277-11287.
